title: N-Queens II
goal: Solve N-Queens II: Explore nonattacking queen placements row by row, counting completed boards rather than storing each board.
strategy: Explore nonattacking queen placements row by row, counting completed boards rather than storing each board.
edgeCases: Only a placement covering every row counts; a dead-end row contributes zero.

checks.condition: col in cols or (row-col) in diag1 or (row+col) in diag2

inputRules: Use an integer n from 1 to 9.
